title: Breadth-first search — shortest path (Python)
description: BFS explores a graph level by level using a queue, so the first time it reaches the target it has used the fewest edges. The standard unweighted shortest-path algorithm.
how_it_works: The queue holds (node, distance) pairs; neighbors are enqueued once, so nodes are visited in order of increasing distance.
complexity: O(V + E) time. Tuning: profile before optimizing; the notes above name the usual bottleneck to measure first.
pitfalls: Needs a visited set — without it, cycles loop forever.
use_cases: Shortest path, level-order traversal, connected components.
